digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate / edit and claim CLI verbs
propositions: Add a --review flag to the edit CLI that, after the EDIT event commits, runs a signed review_plan and maps the verdict to process exit codes (0 PASS / 1 BLOCK / 2 INDETERMINATE / 11 retryable).
The bare --review flag is parsed as a valueless flag that does not consume the following argv token.

Add a --review flag to claim that senses gate applicability via a shared _plan_review_gate_applies helper and claim_gate_check, claims only on PASS, and prints a skip notice when the gate does not apply.
On claim --review, a BLOCK/INDETERMINATE/retryable verdict never invokes the claim core and exits 1/2/11 with the review summary printed.
Neither flag holds the store flock while the multi-minute review runs; the event is appended under a short-lived lock before review begins.
A raising review_plan propagates through the standard CLI error path, leaving an edit committed but never attempting the claim, and the flags are CLI-only (not exposed via MCP or the parent cascade).
